title: Structured Adaptive Tensor Prediction for Streaming Data
abstract: arXiv:2606.10085v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Matrix-valued time series arise in a wide range of applications, such as spatio-temporal data in medical imaging and geophysics. Existing forecasting methods are mainly designed for static settings, while adaptive filtering techniques have been largely limited to scalar- or vector-valued data. In this paper, we develop an adaptive tensor prediction framework for streaming matrix-valued data based on a Tensor-on-Matrix (ToM) regression model, in which the responses in a sliding window are lifted to a third-order tensor and the regression tensor is updated online by stochastic gradient descent (SGD). We derive the leading terms of the steady-state and tracking errors of SGD with overlapping windows, which show that the steady-state error is proportional to the step size and the noise variance, and that the step size governs a trade-off between noise and tracking. We further analyze the statistical accuracy of structured ToM regression

translated_title: 面向流数据的结构化自适应张量预测
translated_abstract: 矩阵值时间序列广泛应用于诸多领域，例如医学影像和地球物理学中的时空数据。现有的预测方法主要针对静态场景设计，而自适应滤波技术则大多局限于标量或向量值数据。本文基于矩阵上张量回归模型，为流式矩阵值数据开发了一种自适应张量预测框架，其中滑动窗口内的响应被提升为三阶张量，回归张量通过随机梯度下降进行在线更新。我们推导了采用重叠窗口的SGD的稳态误差与跟踪误差的主项，结果表明稳态误差与步长和噪声方差成正比，且步长决定了噪声与跟踪之间的权衡。我们进一步分析了结构化ToM回归的统计精度。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于矩阵上张量回归模型和在线随机梯度下降的流式矩阵值数据自适应张量预测框架，并从理论上揭示了SGD的稳态误差与步长、噪声方差的关系以及步长在噪声与跟踪之间的权衡作用。
en_tdlr: This paper develops an adaptive tensor prediction framework for streaming matrix-valued data based on Tensor-on-Matrix regression with online SGD updates, theoretically characterizing the steady-state and tracking errors of SGD and the step-size trade-off between noise and tracking.
